title: Search autocomplete
learning_objectives: Propose and revise an inspectable architecture
problem_statement: Offer type-ahead results for a changing catalog. Clarify ranking, freshness, request cancellation and whether personalized data may enter a shared cache.

progressive_constraints.title: Prefix representation
progressive_constraints.description: Choose an index mechanism that supports bounded prefix results.

progressive_constraints.title: Capacity and cancellation
progressive_constraints.description: Bound query rate per index replica; stale client responses must not replace newer input.

progressive_constraints.title: Fresh updates
progressive_constraints.description: State the indexing delay and compare it with the five-second freshness bound.

progressive_constraints.title: Failure and privacy
progressive_constraints.description: A replica fails and some results are user-specific. Keep an explicit cache scope and fallback policy.

valid_architecture_families.name: Immutable trie snapshots
valid_architecture_families.description: Periodically build a bounded trie and publish it atomically within the freshness budget.

valid_architecture_families.name: Incremental search index
valid_architecture_families.description: Apply updates to a prefix-capable index and expose measured replication/refresh delay.

common_misconceptions: A prefix match alone does not define ranking.
An old network response can overwrite a newer query.
A shared cache can expose personalized suggestions.

hint_ladder.level_1: Decide how results for the prefix are ordered and capped.
hint_ladder.level_2: Compare immutable trie publication with an incrementally updated index.
hint_ladder.level_3: At 10k queries/sec, declared per-replica capacity times available replicas must leave headroom. Track a query epoch to discard stale responses and scope cached suggestions by their authorization boundary.

consolidation: Autocomplete joins prefix retrieval, ranking, freshness, cancellation and privacy. The linked common-prefix exercise introduces prefix reasoning rather than a complete search engine.
fresh_transfer_question: How would a two-second catalog-update requirement change a design that currently rebuilds every minute?
coach_instructions: One clear question at a time. Inspect actual graph and stated assumptions. Do not grade prose by keywords or require a vendor name. Numeric assumptions are learner declarations, not measured performance. Explain when asked, require teach-back, and preserve alternative valid designs. Do not silently edit the diagram.
